title: TaskSpec
description: The structured handoff the on-device conversation loop emits for the cloud agent layer to execute. The local model NEVER does the task; it only produces this.

intent.description: Coarse action class, e.g. book_travel, send_message, reminder, search, unknown

summary.description: One-line restatement of what the user wants, in plain language

slots.description: Extracted parameters relevant to the intent (destination, recipient, timeframe, etc.)

resolved_entities.description: Entities resolved against local memory, e.g. {"g": {"name": "Greg", "phone": "+1..."}}

visual_context.description: What the camera saw, if relevant to the request; null otherwise

needs_clarification.description: True if the request is not yet actionable and the user must be asked a follow-up

clarifying_question.description: The follow-up to speak back if needs_clarification is true
